base_tuple.definition: One independent canonical base tuple excludes condition. Each condition is a paired view rendered from this same tuple; condition views, serializations, and relabelings are repeated measurements, never additional independent units.

color_role_scheme: Deterministic four-distinct-color permutations from colors 1..9 for background, shape, marker, output.

conditions.FIXED_TURN_ROTATION_CONTROL: Same base tuple and output representation; output rotates the input L_TRIOMINO by exactly +1 turn independent of marker, testing transformation execution without marker binding.
conditions.MARKER_BINDING_CONTROL: Same base tuple and marker/layout/color marginals; output is a four-cell direction code with the active position equal to control_marker_turn, testing marker-to-turn interpretation without shape rotation.
conditions.NO_TRANSFORM_RETENTION_CONTROL: Same base tuple and agreed shape rendering; output preserves the input L_TRIOMINO orientation exactly (no canonical-orientation normalization and no marker-dependent transform), testing copying/representation retention.
conditions.ROTATION_TARGET: Output is the input L_TRIOMINO transformed by control_marker_turn, retaining the agreed output rendering.

seed_scheme: seed = 810000 + 104729*condition-independent-base-cell-index + 7919*instance_index; all later draws use local random.Random(seed). Conditions render from the same base tuple and never receive independent seeds.
source_level_limitations: No generator implementation, manifest, grid, model output, or outcome exists.
A later implementation must use a new reviewed source revision and prove deterministic rerun plus content/latent uniqueness before model access.

train_balance.condition_rendering: Every TRAIN base tuple renders all four paired condition views.
train_balance.factor_coverage: Every shape_orientation and every reference_relation appears in multiple allowed TRAIN cells; the four diagonal cells remain excluded.

per_allowed_cell_marginals.color_role_permutation: 24 distinct deterministic permutations with background/shape/marker/output roles; no fixed color-position association
per_allowed_cell_marginals.layout_template: 2 each across the twelve named templates

validation_capacity.source_level_capacity_proof: 4 reserved cells x 12 distinct instance_index values = 48 unique latent tuples. Future content-hash uniqueness is a mandatory pre-generation gate, not established by this static proof.
validation_capacity.unit_count_rule: 48 is total base-tuple count, not per condition; 192 paired views are not 192 independent units.
